description: Extract LLM-ready content from up to 20 URLs in one request. Prefer this over repeated extract calls when grounding an answer in several pages: it is one round-trip, and a URL that fails returns an item with an error instead of failing the batch. Returns results (url, page_content as Markdown, error when that URL failed; metadata with title, mode_used and, when cut, truncated and total_chars) and meta (requested, succeeded, failed). Cloud: billed per URL like extract; failed and empty URLs are free.

clean.description: Article-only extraction (default true). Set false for landing pages, docs indexes and dashboards, where content sits in navigation or feature blocks.

lang.description: Preferred page language, sent as Accept-Language, such as en or de.

maxChars.description: Max characters of content per URL. Default splits 40000 across the batch (at least 2000 each). Longer pages are cut and marked metadata.truncated.

minRunes.description: Minimum text length (in runes) before auto mode escalates to a browser render. 0 uses the built-in floor.

mode.description: auto (default): fast HTTP fetch, browser render if the page comes back empty. fast: HTTP only. rendered: always a browser, for JavaScript-heavy pages.

region.description: Two-letter country code applied to every URL, e.g. US or DE. On Cloud this adds 1 credit per extracted URL.

urls.description: Absolute URLs to fetch and extract. Duplicates are dropped.

useLlmsTxt.description: For a site root URL, return the site's /llms-full.txt or /llms.txt instead when it has one.

name: batch_extract
title: Extract several URLs
